findings.summary: Promo applied is a dead end in Checkout: no path leads on and it isn't a declared exit.
Order Summary has no design for the Card's empty state; show it or say the instance inherits the default.
Order Summary has no design for the Card's error state; show it or say the instance inherits the default.
Order Summary has no design for the Card's loading state; show it or say the instance inherits the default.
The library's Card shows actions by default (Footer), and Fluent iOS CardView has no extension point that expresses it. Nobody has decided it yet.
The library's Card shows body by default (Body), and Fluent iOS CardView has no extension point that expresses it. Nobody has decided it yet.
The library's Card shows header.action by default (.Card header / Header quick action), and Fluent iOS CardView has no extension point that expresses it. Nobody has decided it yet.
The product design changes the Card's state.selected (set-property, true) and no maintainer has reviewed it. Nobody has decided it yet.
Gift options can't be reached from Checkout's entry.
Fluent iOS Button offers Danger, which the Microsoft Fluent 2 iOS Figma kit does not draw. Nobody has decided it yet.
Fluent iOS Button offers Transparent neutral, which the Microsoft Fluent 2 iOS Figma kit does not draw. Nobody has decided it yet.
